newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Unrelenting BTPs have sights on 138.68.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Unrelenting BTPs have sights on 138.68.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE will aim for Fibonacci projections at 138.68 and 138.88 on Wednesday after setting yet another new all-time high in early trade.
"It continues unabated," said David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse Frist Boston in London. "It's very overbought but it's ignoring all overbought considerations."

BTPS were quoted at 138.05 at 0743 GMT, up 49 basis points from Tuesday's settlement but off a new high at 138.18. The 14-day Relative Strength Index was reading 75.42, above the 70 percent level that indicates an overbought reading.
Sneddon said the Fibonacci projections were off drawn of the previous surge higher from around 133.70 in June to the 137.10 high on July 14.
Once above there, the contract would run into sterner resistance from the up channel at 139.00 to 139.26.

To the downside, Sneddon said BTPs would likely try to at least partly fill the gap from Tuesday's high at 137.65 to Wednesday's low so far at 137.90. Below there, there were bands of price support from 137.35 to 137.30 and 137.10 to 137.05.
"It's too early to put any retracements on because there's no evidence that we've formed an interim high here," he said.
"What I certainly wouldn't be doing at the moment is looking for levels to go short at," he said. "It's a very much buy on dips market."
Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures in London, said stochastics have turned up, giving a fresh buy signal.
"This is a very bullish development opening the way for a continuation of the uptrend over the coming weeks to 139.00, which we set as our next objective," he said.
December Eurolire were quoted at 93.36, up three basis points from Tuesday.
